window: OpenRouter public monthly usage and current public model signals

methodology.normalization: Capability uses the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index when published, otherwise a catalog-feature estimate calibrated against benchmarked models with a 10-point text capability floor. Preference combines Arena ratings (70%) and developer request activity (30%) where Arena is available; otherwise it uses request activity. Adoption is log-scaled OpenRouter token volume. Models with no published usage receive zero for request activity and adoption.
methodology.caveat: Flexprice Index is a relative composite of published benchmark scores and reproducible derived metrics. It does not measure FinePrint contract-extraction accuracy or claim that every model has been independently evaluated.
